project.title: Job Fit Copilot
project.content:
# Job Fit Copilot

Contact: jane.doe@example.com · https://github.com/janedoe/job-fit-copilot

## Overview

Built a retrieval-augmented job-fit analyzer in C# on .NET 10 with ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs and PostgreSQL with pgvector. Orchestrated locally with .NET Aspire and instrumented with OpenTelemetry traces and metrics.

## Workflow and Verification

Implemented a graph workflow that extracts job requirements, retrieves CV and project evidence with cosine similarity, scores fit with an LLM judge, and drafts a grounded cover letter verified sentence by sentence against cited chunks.

Senior Backend Engineer (.NET)

Acme Payments is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for our core platform team.

- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

Nice to have:
